evidence.title: Argenx discontinues Vyvgart study in Sjögren's disease, shares tumble

occurrences.checkable_against: STOXX Europe 600 Health Care index (.SXDP) and constituent share-price records for 2026-10-08
occurrences.quote_span: The stock is by far the biggest faller on Europe's downbeat healthcare index (.SXDP), which fell 1.8%
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Argenx efgartigimod study in Sjögren's disease

occurrences.checkable_against: Argenx market capitalization and share-price records at 1109 GMT on 2026-10-08
occurrences.quote_span: The shares were down 16% by 1109 GMT, wiping off €8.5 billion ($9.5 billion) from Argenx's market value
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Argenx efgartigimod study in Sjögren's disease

occurrences.checkable_against: Clinical practice and physician-specialty data on Sjögren's disease diagnosis and treatment
occurrences.quote_span: Sjögren's is primarily diagnosed and treated by rheumatologists.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Argenx efgartigimod study in Sjögren's disease

occurrences.checkable_against: Argenx clinical-trial registry and company announcement on the efgartigimod Sjögren's disease study
occurrences.quote_span: Argenx (ARGX.BR) said on Thursday it had discontinued a late-stage study of its efgartigimod drug in adults with Sjögren's disease, an autoimmune condition that damages the glands producing tears and saliva, putting its shares on track for their biggest one-day fall in almost three years.
occurrences.speaker: Argenx
occurrences.subject: Argenx efgartigimod study in Sjögren's disease

occurrences.checkable_against: Independent data monitoring committee recommendation and interim analysis records for the study
occurrences.quote_span: An independent data monitoring committee recommended stopping the study after an interim analysis concluded the study was unlikely to meet its primary endpoint
occurrences.speaker: independent data monitoring committee
occurrences.subject: Argenx efgartigimod study in Sjögren's disease

occurrences.checkable_against: Regulatory approvals for Sjögren's disease treatments and analyst research reports on Vyvgart trials
occurrences.quote_span: Sjögren's has a high unmet need and no approved treatment, so analysts had seen the trials as a clear opportunity for Vyvgart
occurrences.speaker: analysts
occurrences.subject: Argenx efgartigimod study in Sjögren's disease
